All products distributed on this site are third-party tested for potency, purity, and consistency. They contain no pesticides, residual solvents, heavy metals, or toxic mildew or mold. All phytocannabinoid-rich (PCR) products we produce, manufacture, or distribute fully comply with the 2018 U.S. Farm Bill, which federally legalized the cultivation of industrial hemp under specific federal conditions.

FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION (FDA) DISCLOSURE

The statements made regarding these products have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The efficacy of these products has not been confirmed by FDA-approved research. These products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. All information provided on this site is not a substitute for or alternative to advice from healthcare practitioners. Please consult a healthcare professional about potential interactions or other possible complications before using any product.

NOTICE TO LAW ENFORCEMENT AUTHORITIES

The products on this website may resemble marijuana, but they are legal hemp flower. Recent legislation has established the legality of industrial hemp produced under state pilot agricultural programs. According to 7 U.S.C. §5940, industrial hemp is defined as the plant Cannabis sativa L. and any part of that plant, whether growing or not, with a delta-9 tetrahydrocannabinol (Delta-9 THC) concentration of not more than 0.3% on a dry weight basis.

The Consolidated Appropriations Act, Sec. 763 (2016), further establishes this distinction by confirming that hemp cannot be considered “marijuana” under the Controlled Substances Act. This right applies in all states under the Full Faith and Credit Clause, Article VI, Section 1 of the Constitution; the Supremacy Clause, Article VI, Section 2 of the Constitution; and the Equal Protection Clause, Section 1 of the Fourteenth Amendment.

Our hemp flower contains a Delta-9 THC level well below 0.3% on a dry weight basis and is therefore considered hemp, not marijuana. As such, it is federally legal to possess and sell.

ABOUT OUR HEMP FLOWER

At Lowell Herb Co., we use only premium-quality hemp flower in our products. Each blend is crafted with care, combining naturally occurring terpenes and cannabinoids to provide a unique and enjoyable experience without synthetic additives. Our commitment to quality ensures that you enjoy the authentic essence of the hemp plant in every product.

NOTE ON DOSING

Individual responses to hemp flower vary. For the best experience, we recommend starting with a small amount, such as one or two puffs, and observing how you feel. The effects of hemp flower are typically fast-acting, but allow a few minutes to assess the strength and your comfort level before consuming more. Always adjust your dose according to your personal tolerance and desired effects.
